revision_history: 111.0 froze the formal roster, fit-only training and checkpoint selection, process order, Stage A decision, controls, and claim limits before formal data preparation or training.

111.1 was frozen before formal data preparation or training and only normalizes the execution-protocol digest field name to execution_protocol_sha256 so checkpoint, bundle, and worker schemas are byte-consistent; no scientific or numerical field changed.

111.2 was frozen after real-data preflight but before formal training. It adds fail-closed pair/factor/source/checkpoint identities, heldout-map and array-content binding, and a per-frame q8 exact-adjoint receipt. No roster, model, loss, threshold, cost target, or scientific decision changed.
role: Execution supplement for the already-frozen v111 scientific contract. It resolves training, checkpoint, process, and scoring order without changing the model family, data roster, eight gates, exact-call budget, or claim limits.

parent_contract.precedence: The parent scientific contract wins. This supplement may only make under-specified execution details deterministic.

development_evidence_entry_condition.meaning: The 11-frame pilot signal can be reproduced through the deployment-only worker. This is an engineering entry condition, not cross-trajectory evidence.

formal_roster.outer_fold_order: leave out each trajectory in trajectory_order; preserve the remaining trajectory order

factor_contract.family: frozen calibrated loaded q8 rank factor
factor_contract.identity_derivation: derive the complete expected factor identity from each frozen expanded scenario, the frozen formal geometry, and only these fixed parameters; never infer expected parameters from the candidate artifact manifest

fit_data_preparation.allowed_truth: only the four fit trajectories of the current outer fold and only the seven fit maps
fit_data_preparation.forbidden_truth: the outer-heldout trajectory and all six heldout composed maps
fit_data_preparation.previous_frame_rule: frame 0 repeats current; every other selected frame t reads t-1 from the same trajectory
fit_data_preparation.normalization: current-frame observation RMS independently per trajectory, geometry, map, and frame
fit_data_preparation.train_group_definition: one trajectory by geometry by train-frame group containing all seven fit maps so the paired equivariance loss never mixes trajectories or geometries
fit_data_preparation.group_shuffle: NumPy PCG64 seeded by the frozen model seed; one new permutation of the 120 groups per epoch

optimization.model: the frozen 42237-parameter DRC-Warm model, jointly conditioned on all three known geometries
optimization.precision: float32 model and differentiable training physics; float64 exact checkpoint selection and heldout scoring
optimization.hyperparameter_source: copied unchanged from the preregistered v111 pilot protocol; no pilot metric was used to tune these values

fit_only_checkpoint_selection.evaluation_schedule: evaluate the initialized epoch -1 checkpoint and every completed training epoch
fit_only_checkpoint_selection.cell_roster: four fit trajectories by three geometries by seven fit maps at physical frame 100
fit_only_checkpoint_selection.candidate: DRC-Warm observable line search plus unchanged exact CGLS K1
eight_normalized_cell_values: candidate field divided by Zero-K2 field
candidate full-gradient divided by Zero-K2 full-gradient
candidate interior-gradient divided by Zero-K2 interior-gradient
candidate observation divided by Zero-K2 observation
candidate field divided by Zero-K4 field and then divided by 1.01
candidate full-gradient divided by Zero-K4 full-gradient and then divided by 1.01
candidate interior-gradient divided by Zero-K4 interior-gradient and then divided by 1.01
candidate observation divided by Zero-K4 observation and then divided by 1.01
fit_only_checkpoint_selection.trajectory_geometry_score: maximum of all eight normalized values across the seven fit maps
fit_only_checkpoint_selection.primary_checkpoint_score: maximum trajectory_geometry_score across the four fit trajectories and three geometries
tie_break_order: lower mean of all 84 by 8 normalized values
lower mean differentiable fit-only validation loss
fit_only_checkpoint_selection.patience_definition: stop after 12 consecutive completed epochs without a lexicographic improvement larger than the numeric tolerance in the first differing floating criterion

deployment_bundle_contract.one_bundle_per: outer-heldout trajectory by geometry by heldout map; shared read-only across the three seed workers
members: 101-frame observation array with only causally required frames populated

prediction_and_scoring_order.step_1: freeze one checkpoint for the current outer fold and seed using fit data only
prediction_and_scoring_order.step_2: only after all 15 checkpoints are sealed, generate the 90 heldout deployment bundles and private scoring truths
prediction_and_scoring_order.step_3: run exactly one deployment-only worker per checkpoint by geometry by heldout map; worker receives no truth or scorer path
prediction_and_scoring_order.step_4: seal 270 prediction directories, checkpoint and array digests, and 2970 per-frame 2A+2AT receipts whose first AT is bound to a q8-generation receipt
prediction_and_scoring_order.step_5: only after the global prediction barrier, permit the scorer to read heldout truth
prediction_and_scoring_order.step_6: independently rebuild the roster, metrics, eight gates, tails, exact-call ledger, and truth-mutation noninterference

execution_closure_contract.fit_pair_bundle_before_read: verify directory identity, trajectory manifest, READY, checksums file, every checksummed payload, shape, dtype, and no symlink for exactly the four fit trajectories
execution_closure_contract.factor_before_use: load through the calibrated-factor validator and bind manifest plus READY content digests per geometry into the checkpoint
execution_closure_contract.source: record the clean source commit in checkpoint and report; formal worker must execute from the same clean commit
execution_closure_contract.checkpoint: hash checkpoint bytes after atomic creation; formal worker must receive and verify the expected checkpoint SHA-256
execution_closure_contract.runtime: record Python, NumPy, PyTorch, device, thread counts, and deterministic-algorithm state
execution_closure_contract.claim_boundary: API-level read roster and content binding do not prove process-level filesystem non-access

stage_a_decision.cell_gate: all four ratios versus Zero-K2 are at most 1.0 and all four ratios versus Zero-K4 are at most 1.01
stage_a_decision.trajectory_scope: all 198 cells for one heldout trajectory: six heldout maps by three geometries by eleven frames
stage_a_decision.seed_rule: all five heldout trajectories must pass separately for each of the three seeds

always_score_with_stage_a: normalized geometry-equalized backprojection plus CGLS K1
loaded q8 factor plus CGLS K1
only_if_all_seed_stage_a_passes: v29-style temporal 3-D CNN without pose or map channels
pose-conditioned CNN without reference-chart map channels
control_order_after_stage_a.reason_for_staging: the parent decision order evaluates matched accuracy before learned advantage; a failed DRC-Warm candidate is closed rather than rescued by training additional models

formal_stop_rules.invalid_preflight: stop before training and repair only the explicit identity, shape, adjoint, factor, or causal-input defect
formal_stop_rules.any_seed_stage_a_failure: record the complete negative result and close DRC-Warm at the frozen capacity
formal_stop_rules.simple_control_dominance: retain the simple control and reject learned-advantage
